title: Mass gap for the hierarchical sinh-Gordon model
summary: The (massless) sinh-Gordon model is defined in terms of a continuum massless Gaussian free field perturbed by a cosh interaction. For the hierarchical version of the model, we prove existence of the infinite volume limit, a uniform log-Sobolev inequality, and a mass gap. Our results hold for all $b^2 \in (0,1)$ and simplify for $b^2 \in (0,1/2)$ for which the Gaussian multiplicative chaos has two moments.
